content_sections.heading: About IPRCL
content_sections.text: Indian Port Rail & Ropeway Corporation Limited is a Joint Venture Company between 11 Major Ports under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, which hold 90% of the equity, and Rail Vikas Nigam Limited under the Ministry of Railways, which holds 10%. It was set up to provide efficient rail evacuation systems to Major Ports and to raise their capacity and throughput. It was registered on 10th July 2015 as a Public Limited Company under the Companies Act, 2013. Its Corporate Office is in Mazgaon, Mumbai, and its Registered Office is in Lodhi Road, New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian citizens. The crucial date for eligibility with reference to age, essential educational qualification and length of experience is 04.12.2026. Full time Degree in Electrical Engineering from a recognized University. The educational qualification is not applicable for candidates applying on deputation. Required experience: Execution of Infrastructure Projects. Only experience gained after the minimum educational qualification counts towards eligibility. Preferred experience: working in Railway Electric Traction Projects, General Power Supply Projects, Air Conditioning, Building electrifications, Roads Lightings etc. Officers should be presently working on regular basis (on absorption) or on contract basis in Railways, other Govt. departments, Central PSUs, Ports, JV Companies under Govt. Control or a Private Company, subject to the following: CDA scale officers: working in PB-3 (15600-39100) + GP 6600/- (pre-revised 6th CPC), revised to matrix level 11 under 7th CPC; OR working in PB-2/3 + GP Rs. 4800/5400 (pre-revised 6th CPC), revised to matrix level 8/9 under 7th CPC, with minimum 04 years in Group 'A' or minimum 08 years of Group 'B' service in the grades. IDA scale officers: working in IDA scale Rs. 32900-58000 (pre-revised 2nd PRC), revised to 80000-220000 under 3rd PRC, with minimum 08 years of Managerial/Executive level service; OR working in IDA scale Rs. 29100-54500 (pre-revised 2nd PRC), revised to 70000-200000 under 3rd PRC, for a period of 02 years and with minimum 8 years of Managerial/Executive level service. Deputation, regular CDA officers: working in Senior Scale, i.e. PB-3/GP 6600 (pre-revised 6th CPC) revised to matrix level 11 (7th CPC), with 05 years of Group A service; or in Senior Scale with 8 years of Group B service; or GP 5400 with 11 years in Group B service. Private company officials: working at the level of JGM equivalent and above with a minimum gross salary of at least Rs.1.25 lacs per month; Managerial level service experience of at least 12 years; and working in a company engaged in Execution of Infrastructure Projects/Railway works whose Sales Turnover for the preceding year is at least Rs. 200 Crs. Higher grade pay or pay scale granted under ACP/MACP/NF by the parent department is not taken into account for these criteria. Employees presently working on the rolls of IPRCL get age relaxation over the upper age limit to the extent of their service in IPRCL, subject to meeting all other eligibility criteria. The applicant should be physically and medically fit. On selection, the candidate will have to undergo a medical examination as per the corporation's policy. Candidates should check the official notification (Annexure-I) for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: On Absorption: IDA Scale of pay Rs. 80000-220000/- + Applicable Allowances + PRP (for IDA as per Policy). On Deputation: Parent Pay & Allowances + Deputation Duty Allowance + Other Allowances applicable to deputationist as per Company Policy. Statutory deductions for EPF (employees' share), Income Tax, Professional Tax etc. apply as per rules. Terms of appointment: On Absorption OR On Deputation for 03 years, extendable further as per rules, subject to extension of exemption from the rule of immediate absorption beyond 01.11.2028 by Ministry/DPE. Service conditions follow the Offer of Appointment, HR Policies of IPRCL and orders issued by IPRCL from time to time. A three-month advance notice is required before seeking resignation from IPRCL. Posting is tentatively at Mumbai or Bhubaneswar, but the officer can be posted anywhere in India.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection involves a Personal Interview. Suitable candidates will be shortlisted on their eligibility/experience in the relevant field and may be called for interview. Where there are 05 or more eligible candidates for each vacancy, IPRCL reserves the right to shortlist in the ratio of 1:5. The interview may be held at the Corporate Office of IPRCL, through V.C., or at any other location at IPRCL's discretion. Interview intimation will be sent through e-mail/IPRCL website; candidates should keep checking the website rather than wait for e-mail. Original documents of qualification, experience and age are verified at the interview. A candidate whose identity is in doubt, who cannot produce the documents, whose documents mismatch or who is found ineligible will not be allowed to appear in the interview, and the candidature will be cancelled. Shortlisted candidates serving in government bodies, PSUs, Ports or JV companies must submit a No Objection Certificate from their employer at the interview. Travelling expenses for appearing in the Personal Interview will be paid as per Company Policy.

content_sections.text: A candidate eligible for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. False, tampered or suppressed information leads to cancellation of candidature, and services are liable to be terminated if detected after appointment. IPRCL will not correspond about deficiencies in applications, or with candidates found ineligible, not shortlisted or not selected. IPRCL may increase or decrease the number of posts or cancel the Vacancy Circular wholly or partly at any stage. Disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of courts at Mumbai only. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IPRCL JGM (Electrical) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 02 posts of JGM (Electrical)/E5, tentatively 01 at Mumbai and 01 at Bhubaneswar.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IPRCL JGM (Electrical) post?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the application is 04.12.2026 (4 December 2026).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for IPRCL JGM (Electrical)?
faq.answer: A full time Degree in Electrical Engineering from a recognized University, with experience in execution of infrastructure projects; the degree condition does not apply to candidates applying on deputation.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for IPRCL JGM (Electrical)?
faq.answer: Up to 50 years on absorption and up to 57 years on deputation, as on 04.12.2026, with relaxation for IPRCL employees to the extent of their IPRCL service.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of IPRCL JGM (Electrical) E5?
faq.answer: On absorption, the IDA scale of pay is Rs. 80000-220000/- plus applicable allowances and PRP; on deputation, parent pay and allowances plus Deputation Duty Allowance apply.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for IPRCL JGM (Electrical)?
faq.answer: Send the Annexure-II or Annexure-III form with self-attested enclosures by post, courier or by hand to the Chief General Manager (HR), IPRCL, 4th Floor, Nirman Bhavan, Mumbai Port Trust Building, M.P. Road, Mazgaon (E), Mumbai- 400010.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for IPRCL JGM (Electrical)?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted on eligibility and experience, in a 1:5 ratio where there are 05 or more eligible candidates per vacancy, and selection is through a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Can private company employees apply for IPRCL JGM (Electrical)?
faq.answer: Yes, if working at JGM-equivalent level or above with a gross salary of at least Rs.1.25 lacs per month, 12 years of managerial service, in a company with a preceding-year turnover of at least Rs. 200 Crs in infrastructure projects/railway works.

faq.question: Q9. What is the tenure of the IPRCL JGM (Electrical) appointment?
faq.answer: The appointment on absorption or deputation is for 03 years, extendable further as per rules, subject to extension of the exemption from immediate absorption beyond 01.11.2028 by Ministry/DPE.

faq.question: Q10. Will IPRCL pay travelling expenses for the interview?
faq.answer: Yes, travelling expenses will be paid to candidates appearing in the Personal Interview as per Company Policy.
